attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Raman K as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026 in the regular capacity.
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also appointed Mr. Raman K as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel effective November 12, 2026, superseding his interim role. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 6,625.55 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 601.35 million rupees. Earnings per share stood at 39.79. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 11,793.76 million rupees, with a profit after tax of 1,057.31 million rupees. Earnings per share were 69.96. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 15,691.02 million rupees. The Limited Review Report by S R Batliboi & Associates LLP is enclosed.

attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited has scheduled a conference call with analysts and institutional investors to discuss its 2QFY27 financial performance. The meeting is set for Friday, 13th November 2026, at 10:00 AM IST. Management representatives participating include Nagaraja Gargeshwari, President and Whole-time Director; Raman K, Interim Chief Financial Officer; and Kishan Kumar Udupi, Whole-time Director of Meritor HVS India Ltd. The intimation is provided in compliance with Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The event is organized by 360 ONE CM Research.

attchmntText: Automotive Axles Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication w.r.t Notice to Shareholders regarding Opening of Special Windowfor Transfer and Dematerialisation (Demat) Of Physical Shares.
voiceSummary: Automotive Axles Limited published the third newspaper advertisement regarding the notice to shareholders for the opening of a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical shares. This disclosure was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The publication complies with the SEBI circular dated 30th January 2026. Previous notices were published on 28th February 2026, 10th June 2026, and 3rd September 2026. The information is available on the company website at www.autoaxle.com. The notice was signed by Debadas Panda, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on 7th November 2026.
